run.scope: Flutter MVP, functional review, and local App Store preflight without upload
run.skill_revision: local app-product-factory skill; revision marker unavailable

worked: Market gate rejected the generic 21-day check-in concept and produced a distinct behavior-experiment loop before implementation.
Save-before-commit local persistence, pure derived statistics, bilingual copy, and explicit science/privacy boundaries kept the core small and testable.
Three independent functional review passes found and closed archived-report, milestone, recovery, civil-date, locale, and long-content defects.
The final quality gate passed formatting, analysis, 24 tests, Android Debug build, and unsigned iOS Release archive.
failed: The first implementation hid most archived report data and allowed invalid milestone review state after progress correction.
The second review found archived time statistics were not frozen and long archived titles were not fully readable.
Mechanical App Store preflight remains blocked by intentionally unresolved production identity, signing, URLs, assets, screenshots, and ASC state.
untested: Physical devices, iOS 15 runtime, Android runtime, VoiceOver/TalkBack, full Dynamic Type, landscape, background/low-storage behavior, true airplane mode, and time-zone movement.
Signed distribution archive, Xcode Privacy Report, public URL content, App Store Connect metadata, upload, TestFlight, and App Review.

lessons.symptom: An archived durable report initially hid detail, then allowed time-based statistics to decay and long titles to remain truncated.
lessons.cause: The initial acceptance path focused on the active report; archived rendering used a summary-only widget and later anchored statistics to the live controller clock.
lessons.proposed_change: Add an archived-output checklist and a fixture where archivedAt is earlier than the review clock, with full-title and report-tail assertions.
lessons.regression_check: Archive a long-title experiment, advance the review clock, keep another experiment active, then assert the archived report remains readable and its rate stays frozen.
